title: Cocycle Relations and Elliptic Gamma Values
summary: Recent work of Bergeron-Charollois-García proposed a conjectural analytic expression for elliptic units for complex cubic fields as the special values of smoothed quotients of elliptic Gamma functions. These values depend on the conductor ideal, ray class group element, smoothing ideal, and an admissible element $h$. If this analytic expression is to fit into the framework of explicit class field theory, then, as in the case of torsion points on CM elliptic curves, the resulting complex number should depend only on the congruence class of $h$ modulo a fractional ideal.
